name: ODE Solver Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for ordinary differential equation solver CDGs and SciPy solve_ivp-style atoms.

operations.name: Detect Stiffness
operations.intent: Flag derivative dynamics that may require a stiff solver before advancing the state.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for equations whose fastest and slowest changes are too different for a simple stepper.

rewrite.before_summary: Derivative evaluation feeds state advancement directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A stiffness detector is inserted before advancing the state.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds solver-suitability evidence before numerical integration proceeds.

operations.name: Check Energy Conservation
operations.intent: Validate whether state advancement preserves expected invariants.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for energy drift after each solver advance.

rewrite.before_summary: Advanced states flow downstream without invariant checks.
rewrite.after_summary: An energy-conservation check is inserted after state advancement.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds invariant-quality evidence without changing the state trajectory contract.

operations.name: Validate Order Of Accuracy
operations.intent: Check whether observed error reduction matches expected solver order.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check that smaller steps are reducing error at the expected rate.

rewrite.before_summary: Error estimates flow downstream without empirical order evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An order-of-accuracy validator is inserted after error estimation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds numerical reliability evidence for the solver step.

operations.name: Monitor Step Rejection Rate
operations.intent: Detect excessive rejected steps after adaptive step-size control.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for an adaptive solver that is rejecting too many attempted steps.

rewrite.before_summary: Adaptive step-size decisions flow downstream without rejection-rate evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A step-rejection monitor is inserted after step-size adaptation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds efficiency and stability evidence for the adaptive solver.

audit.rationale: sciona-atoms owns SciPy integrate wrappers, including solve_ivp, that provide an obvious provider context for matcher ODE solver refinements.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make ODE solver pipelines report stiffness, conservation, accuracy order, and adaptive-step rejection behavior.

references.title: Matcher ODE solver expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/ode_solver.py.
